rows.grounds: compound of nava (nine) and yoni (source/womb), accusative object of kuryyāt
compound of prokta (stated) and māna (measure), instrumental means
optative prescription of ritual making, root kṛ

items.question: How should the nine-yoni be constructed according to the stated measure?
premises: The nine-yoni is the object to be made.
The stated measure governs the construction.
The optative verb prescribes ritual action.
items.inference: The verse prescribes making the nine-yoni by the stated measure.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of yoni remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Thus one should make the nine-yoni by the stated measure.
